self_assessment: Added AnsiblePluginError(AnsibleError) carrying plugin_load_context and retired AnsiblePluginRemoved in favour of AnsiblePluginRemovedError, with AnsiblePluginCircularRedirect and AnsibleCollectionUnsupportedVersionError re-parented onto it. loader.py gained the get_with_context_result namedtuple and get_with_context; get now just returns .object, and every failure path returns a structured result with object=None plus populated context. _find_fq_plugin raises AnsiblePluginRemovedError on a tombstone, and find_plugin_with_context no longer emits legacy deprecation warnings itself. task_executor._get_connection uses get_with_context; action/__init__._configure_module resolves via find_plugin_with_context and raises AnsibleError when a redirect target cannot be loaded; template __getitem__ surfaces AnsiblePluginRemovedError as TemplateSyntaxError. Display gained get_deprecation_message (superseding TAGGED_VERSION_RE, now deleted along with the unused re import) and deprecated() delegates to it and raises AnsibleError when removed. Verified: message formatting for version/date/collection/removed variants, the error hierarchy and context attribute, get_with_context returning a resolved plugin vs a structured miss, 21 executor+plugin unit tests passing, and a real playbook running clean. One display warning test fails identically on the clean base; some test modules cannot be collected because this environment's jinja2 is too new for the 2020-era tree.
